== Biography ==
{{EuroAristo Sticker|place=Scotland}}

John Bruce, son of [[Bruce-3711|William Bruce]] and [[Halkett-118|Mary Halkett]], was baptised on 10 November 1664 in the parish of Edinburgh, Midlothian.<ref>
"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, 
National Records of Scotland, 
([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 18 April 2025), 
Surname BRUCE, Forename JOHN, Parents/Other details WILLIAM SIR/BRUCE MARY HACKET FR1799 (FR1799), Gender M, Birth Date 10/11/1664, Parish Edinburgh; 
citing Parish Number 685/1, Ref 60/389, Frame 1799.
</ref>

He died at Glasgow on 19 March 1710 and, having no male heirs, the title became extinct.<ref>
Cokayne, George E. (George Edward), 1825-1911, ''[https://n2t.net/ark:/13960/t7pp2gx6c Complete baronetage]'', database, 
([https://archive.org/details/completebaroneta04coka/page/270/mode/2up?view=theater Internet Archive] : accessed 18 April 2025); 
citing Exeter : W. Pollard & co., ltd, 1900, volume v.4, page Page 270 (288/492).
</ref>

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns John Bruce. The printed Edinburgh marriage register records Marion Glasgow with John Bruce, smith, on 4 July 1684.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 685 / 1/440 / 251; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record]; Henry Paton, ed., Register of Marriages for the Parish of Edinburgh, 1595–1700 (Scottish Record Society, 1905), printed pp.267 and 96; PDF pp.277 and 106; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=106 record]; Same edition, unnumbered Prefatory Note, PDF p.9; [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=9 record].</ref> The printed transcription and its preface were visually inspected on 30 September 2026; original parish image unchecked. The identification remains uncertain.
